Maya (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock scope for the Q3 'predictive cache' work. Asking runtime / infra / security for: minimal launch criteria, infra commitments, and known blockers. Need owners by EOD Fri so roadmap can be updated.
Tom (Eng Runtime): For runtime: main unknown is quantized kernel perf on long sequences. Can we relax p95 target to 150ms for seq<=512 during beta?
Kevin (Eng Infra): Infrastructure note: dedicated pool needs ~8 GPUs reserved to reach target throughput. Lead time for reservations is ~6 weeks unless we use hosted burst. Need NLB change and subnet prep.
Anita (Security): Need threat model + KMS integration before customer-facing launch. If embeddings touch customer PII we escalate to DLP review; that adds ~2 weeks.
Ryan (Product Eng): Can we ship as opt-in toggle initially? That reduces infra commitment and lets us validate perf with fewer customers.
Maya (PM): Proposed launch criteria (please ack or suggest edits):
- perf: p95 <= 150ms for seq<=512 on canary traffic
- reliability: error rate <0.5% over 24h
- rollback: automated fallback to hosted model variant on latency spike
- security: KMS + audit logs enabled for beta customers
- observability: per-request token-level latency + tracing
Please assign owners inline.
Tom (Eng Runtime): Owner: kernel perf = Tom. Timeline: 3 weeks for optimizations; mitigation: smaller batch size + continuous batching tweak as fallback.
Kevin (Eng Infra): Owner: infra reservations + NLB = Kevin. Action: open ticket ENG-INF-421 (created). Need staging IP allowlist and subnet prep: 10.0.4.0/24.
Anita (Security): Owner: security signoff = Anita. Action: I need the threat model doc and design diagram; DLP triage scheduled after that. HSM/KMS path required for enterprise accounts.
Ryan (Product Eng): Owner: rollout gating = Ryan. Plan: feature flag + canary config, start 10% canary, monitor latency and errors for 72h.
Maya (PM): Risks and mitigations: 1) perf regression — mitigation: canary + fallback to non-quantized variant; 2) infra lead time — mitigation: start hosted canary and request reserved GPUs in parallel; 3) security delays — mitigation: internal beta until signoff.
Tom (Eng Runtime): Ping infra on ENG-INF-421 re: allowlist and test VPC. We also need kernel CI comparison against last stable for perf regressions.
Kevin (Eng Infra): ACK. I'll schedule a 30-min sync and open RFC for NLB change. ENG-INF-421 created at 4500000135.
Anita (Security): Sending threat model template to the thread. Please fill and tag me when ready.
Maya (PM): Confirming dates: kernel perf opt by 2025-04-10, infra reservations by 2025-05-01, security signoff by 2025-04-20. If anyone can't meet these, flag here immediately. :eyes: 
Ryan (Product Eng): Noted.
Tom (Eng Runtime): Noted.
Kevin (Eng Infra): Noted.
Anita (Security): Noted.
deploy-bot: Ticket ENG-INF-421 created by Kevin at 4500000135.
Maya (PM): Thanks all — I'll update the roadmap doc and ping sales/support. Closing loop unless new blockers appear.
